generatedProse.practice-connection: In any subject, progressing means getting better at the demanding parts of the work: making an argument, handling the methods, weighing the evidence. A growth mindset, self-belief and well-set goals are what carry you through those when they feel hard. Treat what follows as being about your own modules and assignments, not about study in the abstract.

_prompts.practice-connection: Recast the generic 'In real academic practice' section in the learner's own subject: show how this topic applies in their actual academic work, with the academic framing first and any professional connection kept brief, as a natural follow-on from the generic version above. One or two short paragraphs; academic framing first, any professional connection kept brief.
